messages:
Jordan: Quick thread 52 planning to land docs PR #509 (SDK examples + migration notes) during the 3pm docs merge window. Netlify preview is failing due to artifact shard conflict. Should we gate or do a content-only merge?
Leah: If the failure is artifact-writing only, a content-only merge is okay as long as we remove or downscale the huge SVGs. I can push a small patch.
Marcus: ci-bot reports: 
ci-bot: Build failed for branch docs/sdk-migration-509 52 Error: EBUSY writing artifact shard 7. Attempting retry.
Yara: Two quick options: revert the large SVGs in this branch and land, or push optimized assets to the same branch and re-run preview. Both fine. Which is faster?
Jordan: Timewise probably revert to optimized images and re-run. Leah, can you prepare that now?
Leah: Can do. Will replace svgs with PNG fallbacks and update the PR in 8 minutes. Leaving a placeholder alt text note.
Marcus: I'm doing a fast content review now. Main thing: the migration step for token caching needs an example command; adding that as an inline snippet.
Jordan: Please note any link targets that might break. We want to avoid releasing with 404s in the embedded API refs.
Leah: Local `mkdocs serve` check command I used: 
```\npip install -r docs/requirements.txt
mkdocs serve -a 127.0.0.1:8001
```\nPreview served, snippet renders. API reference links fail locally because of site_url mismatch (use `mkdocs build` with correct `site_url` to test).
Marcus: Approved for content after I added token caching example and corrected heading levels.
Yara: Quick deploy note: if Netlify fails again, maintainers can merge with `merge: maintainer` and mark `docs: force-merge` in the commit message. Only do that if CI can't recover before the window ends.
ci-bot: New deploy attempt created: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/1942000299 (in progress). Logs: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/1942000299#logs
Leah: Pushed optimized images, updated PR. Should be a quick rebuild.
Marcus: Doing a lightweight link check now. Minor broken anchor in migration guide fixed.
Jordan: All right, approvals in-thread: Marcus approved, Leah approved on image change. If Netlify succeeds before 3:15pm, we merge.
ci-bot: Deploy 1942000299 succeeded: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/1942000299
Jordan: Merging now. Reminder to include `docs-release` tag in the merge commit message and a short note in the release notes board.
Leah: Will follow-up with a separate PR to re-add optimized inline SVGs with a note about CDN processing.
Yara: Thanks team 52 leaving a follow-up checklist: 1) confirm no 404s in the live site, 2) verify code snippet copy/paste works, 3) add migration note to release notes doc.
Marcus: I'll run a quick spot check against the live preview after merge.
Jordan: Merged at 15:04. Closing thread.
